summary: Sandbach United fell to a 3-2 defeat against Foley Meir in a frustrating encounter where they created plenty of chances but couldn't capitalize on them, with goalkeeper heroics from the opposition denying them a draw. Saul Shotton's fine far post volley gave them hope late on, but ultimately poor defending from set pieces and missed opportunities proved costly. The Bach will look to bounce back when they face Stafford Town on Saturday.
